topics.name: Core Java
topics.blurb: Collections, generics, streams, records, exceptions, equals/hashCode
outline: JDK/JRE/JVM, Java 17/21 LTS features (records, sealed classes, pattern matching, text blocks, virtual threads)
equals/hashCode contract, immutability, String pool
Collections: List/Set/Map implementations and complexity; HashMap internals
Generics, wildcards, type erasure
Streams and lambdas, Optional
Checked vs unchecked exceptions, try-with-resources
Interfaces vs abstract classes, default methods
Concurrency utilities: ExecutorService, CompletableFuture, ConcurrentHashMap, synchronized vs Lock

topics.name: JVM Internals & Performance
topics.blurb: Memory, GC, class loading, profiling and tuning
outline: Heap, stack, metaspace, memory areas
Garbage collectors: G1, ZGC, Parallel; generational GC
OutOfMemoryError types and diagnosis (heap dumps, jcmd, jmap)
Thread dumps and high-CPU diagnosis (jstack, async-profiler)
JIT compilation and warm-up
Class loading and classpath problems
Container awareness: -XX:MaxRAMPercentage, CPU limits
Common JVM flags in production

topics.name: Spring & Spring Boot
topics.blurb: IoC, Boot auto-config, REST, data access, transactions, security
outline: Inversion of control, bean scopes, dependency injection styles
Spring Boot auto-configuration, starters, profiles, externalized config
Building REST APIs: @RestController, validation, exception handling
Spring Data JPA, repositories, N+1 problem, lazy loading
@Transactional: propagation, isolation, self-invocation pitfall
Spring Security basics: filter chain, JWT/OAuth2 resource server
Actuator, health checks, metrics with Micrometer
Testing: @SpringBootTest, slices, MockMvc, Testcontainers

topics.name: Maven & Gradle
outline: Maven lifecycle and phases, pom structure
Gradle tasks, Kotlin DSL basics
Dependency scopes, transitive dependencies, conflicts and BOMs
Multi-module builds
Reproducible builds and artifact repositories
Dependency vulnerability scanning
